top_signals.title: Joint press release following General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Viet Nam and President of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam Lam Tô Lâm's visit to the European Commission and the European Council
top_signals.summary: European Commission Joint press release Brussels, 22 Oct 2026 On 22 October 2026, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Viet Nam and President of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam Tô Lâm visited the European Union and held talks in Brussels with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President António Costa on bilateral cooperation, regional security and global challenges.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
